title: Nicotinamide riboside promoted cardiac energetics and alleviated doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity via SIRT1/ERRalpha signal in human pluripotent stem cells-derived cardiomyocytes.
authors: Wang, Rui; Zhang, Hua; Yi, Qin; Wang, Yun Peng; Xu, Hao; Tan, Bin; Zhu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究烟酰胺核苷通过SIRT1/ERRalpha信号改善心肌细胞能量代谢，核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Doxorubicin is an antineoplastic chemotherapeutic drug that causes cardiotoxicity with energetics impairment and oxidative stress. Nicotinamide ribose (NR) is the precursor of NAD+ and has demonstrated beneficial effects in several animal models of cardiovascular disease. This study aimed to test the role and mechanism of nicotinamide ribose on human induced pluripotent stem cell-differentiated cardiomyocytes (HiPSCs-CMs) under normal and doxorubicin-treated states. We found that NR increased mitochondrial fusion and integrity in HiPSCs-CMs, promoted mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation levels and ATP output, and increased ERRalpha expression. Inhibition of SIRT1 reversed the beneficial effects of NR. Protein-protein docking and immunoprecipitation showed that SIRT1 may bind directly to ERRalpha and regulates ERRalpha expression. Agonism of SIRT1 shows a facilitating effect on mitochondrial energetics, an effect that is counteracted by inhibitors of ERRalpha. Furthermore, NR promotes mitochondrial energetics via SIRT1/ERRalpha in doxorubicin-induced cardiac cytotoxicity, reduces cardiomyocyte oxidative stress injury, and attenuates apoptosis. Our findings reveal beneficial effects of nicotinamide ribose on HiPSCs-CMs under normal or disease conditions. In conclusion, our study provides the basis for advancing the clinical translation of nicotinamide ribose into the clinic.
abstract_zh: 阿霉素是一种抗肿瘤化疗药物，可导致心脏毒性，伴随能量代谢障碍和氧化应激。烟酰胺核糖（NR）是NAD+的前体，在多种心血管疾病动物模型中显示出有益效果。本研究旨在探讨烟酰胺核糖在正常及阿霉素处理状态下对人诱导多能干细胞分化的心肌细胞（HiPSCs-CMs）的作用及其机制。我们发现，NR增加了HiPSCs-CMs中的线粒体融合和完整性，促进了线粒体氧化磷酸化水平和ATP输出，并增加了ERRalpha的表达。抑制SIRT1可逆转NR的有益效应。蛋白质-蛋白质对接和免疫沉淀实验表明，SIRT1可能直接结合ERRalpha并调控其表达。SIRT1激动剂对线粒体能量代谢具有促进作用，而该效应可被ERRalpha抑制剂所抵消。此外，在阿霉素诱导的心脏细胞毒性中，NR通过SIRT1/ERRalpha促进线粒体能量代谢，减少心肌细胞氧化应激损伤，并减轻细胞凋亡。我们的研究揭示了烟酰胺核糖在正常或疾病状态下对HiPSCs-CMs的有益作用。总之，本研究为推进烟酰胺核糖的临床转化奠定了基础。
